
  ▲ vercel env pull [filename] [options]

  Pull Environment Variables into a local file (default: .env.local)            

  Options:

       --deployment <DEPLOYMENT>    Pull Environment Variables for a specific   
                                    deployment (e.g. dpl_xxx)                   
  -e,  --environment <ENVIRONMENT>  Select the environment to pull (default:    
                                    development)                                
       --git-branch <BRANCH>        Specify the Git branch to pull specific     
                                    Environment Variables for                   
       --project <NAME_OR_ID>       Project name or ID (default: linked project)
  -y,  --yes                        Skip the confirmation prompt when           
                                    overwriting an existing file                


  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default: off)                         
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default: off)                      
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts (default: on when 
                              an agent is detected)                             
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number                         


  Examples:

  - Pull Development Environment Variables into a custom file (check .gitignore)

    $ vercel env pull <file>
    $ vercel env pull .env.development.local

  - Pull Environment Variables for a specific deployment

    $ vercel env pull --deployment dpl_xxx
